name: Wraith
resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical, nonsilvered weapons
condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
languages: The languages it knew in life
notes: CR 5. Life drain reduces HP max. Creates specter thralls.
gm_notes: Session 5 final vault. Life Drain: DC 14 CON save or HP max reduced by damage amount. HP max reduction lasts until long rest. Humanoid killed by Life Drain rises as specter (not under wraith's control). Incorporeal Movement: passes through nonmagical objects.
